definition_en: The ability to inspect, test, and verify that outputs, processes, or services meet defined standards, specifications, and customer requirements.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk memeriksa, menguji dan mengesahkan bahawa hasil, proses atau perkhidmatan memenuhi piawaian, spesifikasi dan keperluan pelanggan yang ditetapkan.
typical_tasks_en:
• Inspect finished garments against size and stitching standards.
• Test each batch of baked goods for temperature and texture before display.
• Audit patient records to ensure compliance with privacy regulations.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Periksa pakaian siap mengikut piawaian saiz dan jahitan.
• Uji setiap kelompok produk bakeri untuk suhu dan tekstur sebelum dipamerkan.
• Audit rekod pesakit untuk memastikan pematuhan peraturan privasi.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires checking outputs against standards or specifications
• The task involves testing products, services, or processes for defects
• The task requires identifying deviations from quality requirements
• The task involves conducting audits or compliance checks
• The task requires documenting and reporting quality issues
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves creating or designing outputs without inspecting them
• The user performs work without any verification or testing step
• The task requires only subjective opinion without defined standards
• The user is analysing trends rather than checking specific outputs
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task creates or analyses outputs without any inspection, testing, or standards comparison.

confusions.boundary_rule: Quality control checks against external standards. Dependability is a personal trait of reliability.
confusions.example_task: Check all outgoing packages against the shipping checklist.
confusions.expected_labels: Quality control; Dependability and attention to detail

confusions.boundary_rule: Quality control verifies standards. Analytical thinking diagnoses causes.
confusions.example_task: Analyse the defect data to find the root cause.

confusions.boundary_rule: Quality control may use senses, but it is about standards compliance.
confusions.example_task: Smell dairy products to check freshness against safety standards.
